Quick FAQ

Where does the download button go?

It opens your Telegram invite link. If that Telegram page contains the app download instructions, follow them there.

Is the app ₹1?

The page highlights your ₹1 promotion. Confirm the final price and any renewal or usage conditions inside the app before paying.

Can I use chat and video calls?

Chat and video calling are presented as app features. Actual availability may depend on the app version and its terms.
